images.title: 04 · Verbund · jetzt
images.caption: Wien · Brücken, Absenkung und Tunnelportale über drei Kacheln.
images.scope: Three full source tiles show the connected bridge/ground/tunnel partial plan. Two real subway axes attach to chosen old ground floors, with C1 scalar height transition and closed lining against selected coarse terrain. Terrain reference is not rendered as a complete earth volume. Other transport/indoor contacts, train routes and structural loads remain unproven.
